artifacts.summary: Widened validate-handoff-location.sh's task-directory quantifier to accept 4+-digit directories, added a 9-fixture regression suite, registered it in the core manifest, and ran the full verification gate set.

completion_data.completion_summary: Widened validate-handoff-location.sh's fixed-3-digit task-directory quantifier ([0-9]{3} -> [0-9]{3,}) so 4+-digit task directories no longer trip a false MISPLACED/HANDOFF_MISLOCATED diagnostic, added a new 9-fixture regression suite (test-validate-handoff-location.sh) pinning both accept and reject sides, and registered the suite in the core manifest's provides.scripts allowlist. Phase 4 closed COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS: run-all.sh and verify-deploy.sh each carry one fully diagnosed, evidenced, plan-anticipated exclusion (an unrelated pre-existing test failure, and the expected staleness of the not-yet-redeployed .claude/ mirror) — neither is a defect in this fix.

memory_candidates.content: When a shell-hook regression suite must exercise a hook's reject branch that calls a sibling script (e.g. system-defect-record.sh) wrapped in `cmd ... >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo note`, the sibling script does not need to be copied/stubbed into the test workdir: the swallow-and-note pattern makes the call's success irrelevant to the hook's exit-code contract. Confirm by reading the wrapper before assuming a stub is required.

To prove a new regression suite actually pins a fix rather than passing vacuously, temporarily revert the fix in a scratch copy of the file under test (sed-substitute the reverted token into a mktemp copy, point a scratch copy of the test file's *_SRC variable at it, run it) and confirm the expected fixtures flip to FAIL while unrelated fixtures stay stable. Restore immediately; never commit the scratch revert.

In this repo, an exact-count regex quantifier on a task-directory digit segment (e.g. [0-9]{3}) is a latent defect class that resurfaces at every order-of-magnitude crossing of specs/state.json's next_project_number. When editing any path-matching pattern keyed to task-directory digits, prefer a minimum-count quantifier ({3,}) over an exact count from the start.
